# Free QR Code Generator — No Sign Up, Instant High-Res Download

> Free QR Code Generator is a client-side utility to create permanent, high-resolution QR codes for URLs, WiFi networks, vCards, SMS, and emails with custom center logos and colors.

Website: https://qr-generator.corelumetech.in/
Developer & Publisher: Corelume Tech (https://corelumetech.in)
Privacy Policy: 100% Client-Side Processing. No user data, files, or strings are collected, stored, or transmitted to any server.

## Overview
Free QR Code Generator is a client-side utility to create permanent, high-resolution QR codes for URLs, WiFi networks, vCards, SMS, and emails with custom center logos and colors.

## Core Features
- Custom center logo embedding with high error correction (Level H)
- Permanent QR codes with zero expiration date and no sign-up required
- Dynamic QR presets: URLs, Wi-Fi passwords, vCard contact cards, pre-filled emails, and SMS
- Custom foreground and background color palette customization
- Batch QR code generation for processing multiple links simultaneously
- High-resolution 512x512 PNG download ready for digital and print media

## Benchmarks & Technical Specifications
- 100% Permanent QR codes (no redirects or subscription lockouts)
- 512x512 Ultra-high-resolution canvas rendering
- Level H Error Correction (supports up to 30% logo coverage)
- Zero tracking, zero cookies, 100% private client-side generation
